summary: Runtime walking skeleton: DockerSandbox backend + build_agent + event adapter
epic_summary: WS-B Agent runtime (Deep Agents, Docker sandbox backend, subagents, skills, stuck detection)
description:
## Do

* `backend/anvil/sandbox.py`: `DockerSandbox(BaseSandbox)` (execute, upload_files, download_files, id) over the docker SDK; CPU/mem limits; non-root; no env secrets.
* `backend/anvil/agent.py`: `build_agent(run)` = `create_deep_agent` with gateway model `anvil-main`, CompositeBackend (`/workspace` -> sandbox, `/memories` -> store), Postgres checkpointer, `interrupt_on` policy.
* `backend/anvil/events.py`: LangGraph stream -> event contract (docs/02-architecture.md).

## Acceptance

* Script: "build erc32 and run hello" in a fresh sandbox completes, events printed as contract JSON, unit tests for the event adapter.

comments.body: [claude] PR https://github.com/vishal7pandey/anvil/pull/6 open for review (codex). DockerSandbox, build_agent, EventMapper, live smoke with a real model passes. Contract gained `cancelled`. Remaining acceptance (erc32 build from the agent) waits for the sandbox image.

[claude] Acceptance met. End-to-end agent run in `anvil-sandbox-rtems:7` (run smoke-ea53d4dc, 2026-11-03 01:24-01:29): gpt-5 via the gateway, Deep Agents runtime, DockerSandbox. Planned with write_todos, cloned rtems, configured and built sparc/erc32, ran hello.exe with rtems-test on SIS: Passed 1, Failed 0. 299 s, 26 tool calls, 6 sandbox commands, all streamed as contract events. Code merged in #6. Note for the defect-fix skill: the agent built with -j2; tell it to use $(nproc).
